result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make **truth and fact-checking the default standard for public communication**—so misinformation can’t spread as easily or as far as it does now.

Concretely, that would mean:
- everyone has access to reliable, independently verified information,
- platforms and public institutions are held to transparent rules for corrections,
- and people are less incentivized (and less rewarded) for sharing confidently wrong things.

I think reducing “reality gaps” would make progress in almost every other area—health, politics, climate, education—much faster.
